reasoning_traces.think:
The core innovation lies in integrating a hierarchical memory system into a multimodal large language model (MLLM) for expert-level commentary. The short-term memory (FIFO) captures immediate tactical dynamics, while the long-term memory consolidates structured statistics across the match. This dual memory architecture enables contextual awareness without requiring full video recency. The video semantic parser extracts structured data from raw video, including scoreboard states, event timestamps, and object trajectories. These elements feed into a trained MLLM that generates commentary conditioned on both visual and symbolic inputs. The model's training objective optimizes for linguistic coherence and alignment with a reference LLM-generated commentary. However, the reliance on LLM-synthesized ground truth introduces potential leakage and limits generalizability to other sports domains. Failure modes include hallucination of facts, misalignment with real-world game state, and degradation under poor video quality or novel tactical scenarios.
